name: Flydoo Technology Holding Limited
summary: Flydoo Technology Holding Limited operates as a travel agent in Hong Kong and Macau. It designs, develops, and sells package tours; and sells air tickets and hotel accommodations, as well as ancillary travel related products and services under the WWPKG brand, as well as invests in tourism and travel technology related businesses. The company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Kowloon, Hong Kong. Flydoo Technology Holding Limited is a subsidiary of WWPKG Investment Holdings Limited.
